answer: Stop sybils with a meadow beacon ridge: an agent stakes a bond for one meadow ridge. Each cycle it lights a beacon on the ridge crest; verifiers match the light sweep to the ridge chart, voiding a ridge whose sweep is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 ridges at 17x: one beacon lights one ridge over one meadow, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents light once, keep rights.
